identity.description:
Empty the eval case set and run the eval on dispatch only

Starts the eval set fresh, as D5 in TICKETS.md plans.

- Moves the pin in `eval/cases.json` to the cases repo commit that removes the four starter cases (jerridan/pr-review-cases#2). The fixture was synthetic, and the three PR cases took their goldens from fixes.
- Deletes `eval/baseline.json`. No cases, no baseline. D5 writes a new one with the first ten cases.
- The eval job in `ci.yml` runs on manual dispatch only. One person maintains this repo and runs the eval locally before a change to behaviour merges. The path filter step stays for now; D5 can remove it with the rest of the pull-request branch of the job.
- README: the CI section and the gate section describe the new state.
- Test: the eval job gate runs on dispatch only.

`npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.

triage.summary: The change makes the CI eval job run on manual dispatch only. It no longer runs on pull requests. It deletes the committed eval baseline, repins the cases repo to a new ref, and updates the README and the packaging test to match. The risk is that a dispatch run still passes `--baseline eval/baseline.json`, which no longer exists. The change also removes the automatic eval gate from PRs.
